credits.title: Antes de nós
credits.overview: 1918, Castelao leaves his public position in Pontevedra to work as a doctor in Rianxo during the Spanish flu. A hero for the town, but an absent man for his wife, Virxinia. 1929, the couple travels through Brittany a few months after the loss of their only son. Two broken beings and a bond that is no longer understood.

credits.title: Live Is Life
credits.overview: Summer 1985. As every year, Rodri travels from Catalonia to Galicia and is reunited with his four friends. As real-world problems begin to undermine their friendship, the five of them embark on a nighttime adventure in search of a mythical object.
